title: NOT CERTIFIED: a leading UNVERIFIED in markdown underscore emphasis (_UNVERIFIED_ / __UNVERIFIED__) still parses as AGREE via the marker substring scan
repro: cd <worktree>/sidecar && ./.venv/bin/python -c "from services.research.verify import _parse_verdict; print(_parse_verdict('_UNVERIFIED_ - no source confirms the 23% operating margin.'))" -> ('agree', ...); same for '__UNVERIFIED__ - evidence does not support the figure'. The entry's three literal strings now read unverified. leading_token strips '*:-#>[]' but not '_', and the standalone \bUNVERIFIED\b check fails because '_' is a word character, so the reason's 'confirm'/'support' decides. The ULTRA brief renders '- **AGREE** - claim' with the detail suppressed (verify.py:398).

title: Entry leg humanize('groq', exc(status_code=413)) with no body still returns code=unknown 'Something went wrong with Groq. Try again'
repro:
PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/python -c "from services.errors import humanize
class Exc(Exception):
  def __init__(s,c): super().__init__(); s.status_code=c
print(humanize('groq', Exc(413)).code)" -> unknown (also openai; and humanize('groq', status=413)). The marker-less 413 context_overflow row in _BODY_RULES is only consulted under 'if raw:' (errors.py:415-418) and the status branches have no 413, so a body-less 413 falls to 'unknown'. With any body (the SDK 'Error code: 413 - ...' string) it reads context_overflow; every other leg of the entry is fixed.

title: NOT CERTIFIED: the eval grader still passes a trial whose tool call errored when a later call of the same tool (a different subject, not a retry) succeeded
repro: grader.grade({expect:{tools:[{tool:'option_chain'}]}}, [tool_use option_chain {symbol:AAPL, expiry:nearest}, tool_result ok=false (real handler output 'invalid argument: Invalid isoformat string'), tool_use option_chain {symbol:MSFT}, tool_result ok=true, delta, done]) -> [] (pass). grader.py:95-104 keys last_result by tool NAME, so any later same-name success masks an earlier failed call on another input; the single-call entry repro now fails correctly.
